# Even Me

> A 90-second daily emotional check-in for mothers of neurodivergent kids. For the mother, not the child.

Even Me is a gentle, non-clinical daily companion. Mothers pick a mood and energy level, get a small piece of advice, affirmation, or a quick tool (breathing, grounding, journaling), and build a quiet streak of showing up for themselves.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What Even Me is and how to start.
- [Explore](/explore): Small tools and warm advice, browsable by feeling.
- [Resources](/resources): Crisis support phone lines and text services.
